notes: Figures were unavailable, so all figure-based results were unverifiable and judged from captions and text. Ran five reviewer passes sequentially in one context (disclosed). Ambiguities: (1) Phase 1.5 literature check is meant to follow the five drafted reports, but the Domain Reviewer's report needs the addendum, so I wrote Phase 1 first and added the addendum afterwards, leaving the other reports unchanged. (2) Hard Rule 10 says garbled equations are unverifiable; Eq. 6 may have lost a floor bracket in extraction, so I downgraded that point after drafting. (3) The DA agent says 'No CRITICAL' is the normal outcome, yet the strongest objection (non-identifiability of the main inference) is arguably 'experiment cannot test the claim' (criterion 2); the criteria text says missing controls are MAJOR, so I filed it as MAJOR and the EIC ruled accordingly. (4) The DA gave Overall 2 with no CRITICAL; the rubrics do not say how DA's Overall relates to its issue list. (5) The pool-position bands (Overall 3 = typical rejected 30-54; <30 = clearly below the bar) leave Overall 2 vs 3 ambiguous for a paper at pool position ~30-40. (6) The skill gives no explicit guidance for which paper type fits a NeuroAI hypothesis-testing paper; I chose 'analysis'. (7) The shell blocked redirects/cat in the sandbox, so I assembled review.md with Python. summary.json fields venue_recommendation and after_composite taken from aggregate.json (label; eic_composite 51.4).
